profile.name: Dejenie Abebe
profile.title: IT Professional
profile.headline: Building Reliable IT Solutions for Modern Businesses
profile.bio: I'm an IT professional experienced in ERP implementation, IT support, networking, system administration, and business technology solutions. I enjoy solving technical problems and building reliable systems that help organizations work more efficiently.
profile.about1: I am a dedicated IT professional with over 5 years of hands-on experience in deploying and managing ERP systems, designing and maintaining enterprise networks, and providing comprehensive IT support to organizations of all sizes.
profile.about2: My passion lies in leveraging technology to solve real-world business challenges. From setting up infrastructure to training end users on complex systems, I bring a holistic approach to every project.
profile.about3: I hold certifications in networking, cybersecurity, and ERP platforms, and I continuously update my skill set to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving technology landscape.

experience.title: IT Manager
experience.description: Led the IT department overseeing network infrastructure, server management, and end-user support. Implemented ERP solutions that improved operational efficiency by 40%. Managed a team of 5 IT technicians.

experience.title: Network Engineer
experience.description: Designed, deployed, and maintained enterprise LAN/WAN networks for corporate clients. Configured Cisco routers and switches, implemented firewall policies, and provided 24/7 network monitoring.

experience.title: IT Support Specialist
experience.description: Provided first and second-line IT support to over 200 employees. Managed help desk tickets, performed hardware/software troubleshooting, maintained Active Directory, and delivered IT training sessions.

experience.title: Junior IT Technician
experience.description: Installed and configured hardware and software for new users. Assisted in network cabling and setup, supported daily IT operations, and maintained IT asset inventory.

projects.title: Enterprise ERP Rollout
projects.description: Full-scale Odoo ERP implementation for a manufacturing company with 500+ users. Covered HR, Inventory, Accounting, and CRM modules.

projects.title: Corporate Network Infrastructure
projects.description: Designed and deployed a multi-site WAN/LAN network with redundancy, QoS, and centralized management for a financial institution.

projects.title: IT Security Assessment
projects.description: Conducted a comprehensive security audit and vulnerability assessment for a government agency, delivering a remediation roadmap and policy updates.

services.title: IT Support & Help Desk
services.description: Fast and reliable IT support for hardware, software, connectivity issues and any system support. Remote and on-site assistance for individuals and businesses.

services.title: ERP Consulting & Implementation
services.description: End-to-end ERP project management from needs analysis and system selection to deployment, customization, and user training.

services.title: Network Design & Administration
services.description: LAN/WAN design, router and switch configuration, wireless deployment, VPN setup, and ongoing network monitoring and maintenance.

services.title: Cybersecurity Services
services.description: Security audits, vulnerability assessments, firewall configuration, security policy development, and employee security awareness training.

services.title: System Administration
services.description: Windows Server and Linux administration, Active Directory management, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), backup, and disaster recovery.

services.title: Cloud Solutions
services.description: Cloud infrastructure setup and migration on Azure and AWS, hybrid cloud integration, cost optimization, and managed cloud services.

chatbot.greeting: Hi there! 👋 I'm Dejenie's assistant. Ask me anything about his skills, experience, projects, or how to get in touch!

faqs.answer: I'm Dejenie Abebe, an IT Professional specializing in ERP implementation, networking, system administration, and cybersecurity. I help organizations build reliable technology solutions.
My top skills include ERP Implementation (Odoo/SAP), Network Administration, Cybersecurity, Windows Server, Linux, Cisco Routing, Cloud Services (Azure/AWS), and IT Project Management.
I have 5+ years of experience. I've worked as an IT Manager, Network Engineer, and IT Support Specialist across multiple organizations. Check the Experience section for full details!
I've completed 30+ projects including Enterprise ERP Rollouts, Corporate Network Infrastructure, IT Security Assessments, Cloud Migrations, and Data Center Setups. Visit the Projects section!
I offer: IT Support & Help Desk, ERP Consulting & Implementation, Network Design & Administration, Cybersecurity Services, System Administration, and Cloud Solutions.
You can reach me at dejenie@email.com or call +251 900 000 000. You can also fill out the Contact form on this page!
You can download my CV using the Download CV button at the top of the page!
I'm based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. I work both on-site and remotely for clients worldwide.
I hold certifications including CCNA (Cisco), Microsoft Azure Administrator, CompTIA Security+, Odoo Certified Professional, CEH (EC-Council), and ITIL 4 Foundation.
I specialize in ERP implementation using Odoo and SAP — from needs analysis and system setup to customization, data migration, and user training.
